title: Trump's Board of Peace faces its biggest test over Gaza

ai.summary: The Board of Peace, a US-led initiative aiming to end the Gaza conflict, faces challenges in ensuring peace and humanitarian aid as violence continues and Palestinian casualties rise.

facts.claim: The Board of Peace, set up under US President Donald Trump's initiative, is approaching a crucial stage.
facts.quote: The Board of Peace, set up under US President Donald Trump's initiative, is approaching a crucial stage.

facts.claim: The Board's May 2026 report to the Security Council referred to the establishment of a 28-member National Committee for the Administration of Gaza (NCAG) and reconstruction pledges amounting to $17 billion.
facts.quote: The Board's May 2026 report to the Security Council also referred to the establishment of an international organisation, a 28-member National Committee for the Administration of Gaza (NCAG), preparations for an International Stabilisation Force (ISF) and reconstruction pledges amounting to $17 billion.

facts.claim: The recent Israeli strike on Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis on November 11 killed at least six people, including a doctor and a 13-year-old boy.
facts.quote: The recent Israeli strike on Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis on November 11, which killed at least six people, including a doctor and a 13-year-old boy, once again exposed the fragile situation.

facts.claim: According to the UN's November 5 humanitarian situation report, 1,593 Palestinians had been reported killed and 5,748 injured since the ceasefire agreement.
facts.quote: According to the UN's November 5 humanitarian situation report, 1,593 Palestinians had been reported killed and 5,748 injured since the ceasefire agreement.

ai.background_note: The Board of Peace, a US-led initiative for Gaza peace, faces challenges in ensuring security and humanitarian aid as violence persists and Palestinian casualties rise.
